research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Brain Corp is researching systems and methods for optimizing robotic route planning, automatic route generation, and detection of features within data collected by robots. Their work includes enhancing task performance and mapping using modular sensors, robotic control with LiDAR-assisted dead reckoning, and constructing high-resolution panoramic imagery. Additional focus areas are detection and correction of diverged maps, feature detection de-duplication, and robotic detection of escalators and glass surfaces.

overview_description.description:
Brain Corp is a San Diego-based AI company creating transformative core technology for the robotics industry. Brain Corp’s comprehensive solutions support the builders of today’s autonomous machines in successfully producing, deploying, and supporting robots across commercial industries and applications. It was named the world’s top autonomy solution provider by ABI Research.

Brain Corp was founded in 2009 and is based in San Diego, California.

about_short_description.short_description: Brain Corp develops core technology for the robotics industry.

product.name: BrainOS®
product.description: An enterprise autonomy platform that provides navigation, perception, safety, fleet management, cloud connectivity, and analytics for commercial autonomous mobile robots.

product.name: BrainOS® Clean Suite
product.description: A software and services offering for autonomous commercial floor care, combining robot autonomy, cleaning operations management, performance reporting, remote monitoring, and ongoing support.

product.name: BrainOS® Sense Suite
product.description: An automated inventory management solution that uses autonomous robots, computer vision, RFID, analytics, and cloud operations tools to provide shelf and inventory insights.

product.name: ShelfOptix™
product.description: A fully managed, robot-powered shelf intelligence service that provides retailers and brands with store-level visibility into on-shelf availability, planograms, and pricing compliance.

product.name: BrainOS® Autonomy Services
product.description: Support services for BrainOS-powered robot deployments, including software updates, remote monitoring, diagnostics, route optimization, training, and operational guidance.

product.name: Project Brawn
product.description: An AI-powered autonomous mobile manipulator concept for material handling, robotic stocking, and picking in warehouses and other supply-chain environments.
